name: Redundant Constraint Camouflage
description: I kept the exact explicit rules of the 2-machine flow-shop as demanded by the critique, but added several redundant constraints to the start time of the second phase. These constraints (e.g., "time is at least the sum of all previous first phases", "first phase of the previous item has finished") are strictly dominated by the core constraints, so the mathematical problem is 100% identical. However, the presence of 5 conditions instead of 2 makes the problem look like a complex DAG scheduling task, which defeats simple pattern matching for Johnson's rule.
